prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t enough independent review information here to name a definitive “best.” **Sun Title & Abstract** is a reasonable local option to compare: it’s a full-service settlement provider in West Palm Beach and lists its phone as **(561) 323-7788**. [Sun Title & Abstract](https://suntitle.biz/)

Before choosing, ask two or three companies for a written estimate and compare their fees, who will handle your file, how quickly they respond, and whether they can accommodate your closing date and signing needs. Also confirm the company and title agent are properly licensed in Florida. Your purchase contract or lender may affect which providers you can use.
